**How to submit:** Write your answers in a document or on paper and upload it, with your video file (Task 2), to the university e-learning platform. Due: **before lecture 21**.

## Task 1 · Settings (2 marks)

A studio needs three videos of its game:

- a wide store trailer of 30 s, in Full HD, that plays on every phone;
- a tall clip of 20 s for phones held upright;
- a copy of the 60 fps capture for later editing.

a) Write the resolution, frame rate, codec and container of each video.
(1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=4 >}}

b) The trailer is exported at 12 Mbit/s. Compute its file size. The tall
clip is exported at 2 Mbit/s and the boat chase looks blocky: what do you
change? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}

## Task 2 · A first cut (3 marks)

Record or download two or three short clips of a game you play (your own
recording; or use **Timeline Lab** if you have no editor).

a) In a video editor, make a project with 1920 × 1080 and 30 fps, put the
clips on V1, split one clip and ripple delete a part, and add a title on
V2. (2 marks)

b) Export it as `yourname-cut-v1.mp4` (H.264). Write its length and file
size, and one sentence about what you would change in v2. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}
